title: Intervention Facilitates Oral Feeding in Premature Infants
brief_summary: Skin-to-skin combined with breastfeeding shortened the cycle of full-oral feeding in premature infants
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* gestational age ≤30 weeks
* birth weight \< 1500g
* age of admission \<72 hours
* no congenital malformation

Exclusion Criteria:

* OI \> 40
* mother has trouble in communicating
